commun.slogan: Claude as project lead; ChatGPT, Gemini and your Mac as backup.
commun.absent_codex: {nom} is not available: Codex CLI (the “codex” program) was not found on this Mac. Install it and sign in with your ChatGPT account.
commun.absent_antigravity: {nom} is not available: Antigravity CLI (the “agy” program) was not found on this Mac. Install it and sign in with your Google account.
mcp.instructions_aucun: YaTeam: no team member is enabled (run “Modify YaTeam” again). Only the quotas_equipe tool is available.
mcp.instructions_deux: YaTeam: Claude is the project lead; {membres} are its team members, two other AIs running read-only on the user's Mac.
mcp.instructions_un: YaTeam: Claude is the project lead; {membres} is its team member, another AI running read-only on the user's Mac.
mcp.instructions_demande: When the user asks to have {noms} work on something, use {outils}.
mcp.role_antigravity: web research, monitoring or summarizing large documents → {nom}
mcp.role_codex: focused review, checking a calculation or a short second opinion → {nom} (often a small quota, especially with a free ChatGPT account: one or two short tasks per 5-hour window{sinon})
mcp.instructions_deleguer: Also delegate on your own initiative, without being asked, whenever it adds value: {roles}. Not for trivial tasks. Tell the user in one line who did what.
mcp.instructions_images: You cannot generate images: faire_une_image has {nom} make them, and YOU choose the project folder to save them in and their file name.
mcp.instructions_fin: They cannot see this conversation: write complete, self-contained instructions. Check their answers before passing them on: they are opinions, not facts. Never send them passwords, keys, tokens or confidential data.
mcp.regles: Read-only: reads the files in the given folder and searches the web, changes nothing. Cannot see this conversation: write complete, self-contained instructions. Never include passwords, keys, tokens or confidential data. If the answer is not ready after ~50 s, the tool returns a task number: then call attendre_reponse with that number.
mcp.param_dossier: Optional: folder on the Mac to read (absolute path or ~/…).
mcp.param_attendre: Optional, true by default. False: returns a task number right away, so the team members can work in parallel while you continue; then collect the answer with attendre_reponse.
mcp.outil_antigravity: Hands a task to {nom}, team member: this is Gemini, through Google's official Antigravity CLI signed in to the user's Google account, on their Mac. Good for web research with sources and reading large documents. Answers in 30 s to a few minutes.
mcp.outil_codex: Hands a task to {nom}, team member: this is ChatGPT, through OpenAI's official Codex CLI signed in to the user's ChatGPT account, on their Mac. Often a small quota (especially with a free account): keep it for short tasks, reviews, second opinions, checks.
mcp.outil_image: Has {nom} generate an image, then saves it where YOU decide: choose the relevant project folder yourself (e.g. the Images or assets folder of the current app) and a meaningful file name; if you really don't know where to save it, ask the user. Mac folder under the home folder only (/Users/<account>/… or ~/…), no hidden folders or Library. Returns the file paths and a preview: check the image before presenting it, and ask again if it doesn't fit. Still images only (no video). If the image isn't ready after ~50 s, the tool returns a task number: then call attendre_reponse.
mcp.param_image_description: What the image shows: subject, style, colors, framing, format (landscape, portrait, square), any text.
mcp.param_image_destination: Folder on the Mac where the image is saved (created if missing).
mcp.outil_attendre: Waits (up to ~50 s) for the answer to a task given to {noms}, using the number returned by {outils}. Call it again while the task is still running.
mcp.outil_quotas: The team's usage quotas ({membres}): share used over 5 h and over the week, reset time, and for images the last quota error received (no member publishes an image counter). Uses no quota.
mcp.delai_depasse: ⚠️ {nom} did not answer within 15 minutes: task stopped.
mcp.en_cours: {nom} is still working (for {s} s). Task no. {tache}: call attendre_reponse with this number to get the answer.
mcp.redemarrer_app: Then quit and reopen the Claude app.
mcp.consigne_vide: Empty instructions: write the task to hand over.
mcp.dossier_introuvable: Folder not found on the Mac: {dossier}
mcp.tache_recue: {nom} got the task. Task no. {tache}: call attendre_reponse with this number when you want the answer.
mcp.dest_hors_maison: the folder must be inside {maison} (not {maison} itself)
mcp.dest_cache: no hidden folder and no Library
mcp.dest_refusee: Destination refused ({raison}): choose a project folder on the Mac.
mcp.description_vide: Empty description: say what the image should show.
mcp.consigne_image_une:
Generate a single image with your generate_image tool, and nothing else: {description}

Do not copy or move the files. Then answer in one or two sentences: what the image shows.
mcp.consigne_image_plusieurs:
Generate {n} variants with your generate_image tool, and nothing else: {description}

Do not copy or move the files. Then answer in one or two sentences: what each image shows.
mcp.tache_inconnue: Unknown task: {tache} (the connector may have restarted with the app; hand the task over again).
mcp.q_claude_indispo: Claude: reading unavailable (is Claude Code installed and signed in?).
mcp.q_antigravity_indispo: {nom}: reading unavailable (Antigravity CLI missing or signed out?).
mcp.q_tiers: (* separate Antigravity quota: third-party models available through {nom})
mcp.q_codex_aucun: {nom}: no reading yet (it will appear after its next task).
script.echec_codex: {nom} could not answer (quota used up or sign-in expired?). End of the Codex log:
script.echec_antigravity: {nom} could not answer (code {code}, quota used up or sign-in expired?). End of the log:
script.preambule: You are {nom}, a team member. Claude, your project lead, gives you the task below. You work READ-ONLY: you may read files and search the web, but you do not create, modify or delete any file, and you do not run any command. If the task asks you to write a file, give its full content in your answer. Only exception: you may use your image generation tool (generate_image); the image stays in your workspace, do not copy or move it, Claude takes care of that. Answer in the language of the task.

conf.cle_pas_objet: {fichier}: the “{cle}” key is not an object
conf.cle_pas_liste: {fichier}: the “{cle}” key is not a list
conf.illisible: {erreur}. Nothing was changed: fix this file (or rename it), then run again.

inst.non_officiel: Unofficial tool: it only runs the official programs you have already installed and signed in to, and never reads or sends any password, token or credential.
inst.pas_de_terminal: This script asks questions: run it in the Terminal, or add --yes.

inst.codex_absent: Codex CLI (codex) not found: no ChatGPT team member. https://developers.openai.com/codex/cli
inst.agy_absent: Antigravity CLI (agy) not found: no Gemini team member. https://antigravity.google
inst.noms_explication: Each member got a random nickname; you can keep it or choose another one.
inst.activer_codex: Add ChatGPT to the team (read-only team member, via Codex CLI)?
inst.activer_antigravity: Add Gemini to the team (read-only team member, via Antigravity CLI)?
inst.aucun_actif: No member chosen: installation stopped, nothing was changed.
inst.titre_plan: What will be done (every changed file is backed up first)
inst.plan_scripts: copy the scripts to ~/.claude/equipe (private folder) and write your settings there
inst.plan_agents: install the Claude Code agents in ~/.claude/agents
inst.plan_crochets: add hooks to ~/.claude/settings.json (to know when Claude is working)
inst.plan_connecteur: add the “equipe” connector to the Claude app and to Claude Code
inst.plan_widget: build the YaTeam panel (quotas and team activity)
inst.sauvegarde_impossible: Could not back up {fichier}: installation stopped, this file was not replaced.
inst.sans_scripts: Nothing can work without the scripts: installation stopped, nothing else was changed.
inst.remplacer: Replace them (a copy will be kept)?
inst.echec_agents_noms: agents not installed (pick other names by running ./install.sh again)
inst.explication_crochets: They tell the panel when a Claude session is working; they never block Claude.
inst.app_absente: The Claude desktop app does not seem to be installed (https://claude.ai/download).
inst.question_connecteur: Add the “equipe” connector to the Claude app?
inst.remplacer_connecteur: Replace it with YaTeam's (a copy will be kept)?
inst.explication_regle: Added between two markers to ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md: Claude then delegates on its own.
inst.explication_widget: Shows the quotas (5 h, week) and who is working, on the desktop or floating. Built on this Mac in 1 to 3 minutes.
inst.swift_absent: Swift not found: no panel (xcode-select --install, then run the installation again).
inst.echec_widget: widget not built (see the messages above)
inst.fin_app: Quit the Claude app completely (Cmd + Q) and reopen it: the “equipe” connector shows up in its connectors.
inst.fin_code: In Claude Code, start a new session (connector, agents and hooks load there).
inst.fin_codex: Codex must be signed in: run “codex” once and choose to sign in with ChatGPT.
inst.fin_agy: Antigravity must be signed in: run “agy” once and sign in with your Google account.
desinst.question_connecteur: Remove the “equipe” connector from the Claude app?
desinst.question_regle: Remove YaTeam's rule from {fichier} (the rest of the file is kept)?
desinst.ouverture_session: If “Open at Login” was turned on, the entry will disappear from System Settings > General > Login Items & Extensions.
desinst.question_widget: Quit the widget and move {app} to the Trash?
desinst.contenu_dossier: It contains the scripts, your settings, the activity status and the backups (including this uninstall's).
desinst.fin_app: Quit and reopen the Claude app so it forgets the connector.
desinst.fin_cli: Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI and Claude Code stay installed and signed in: they are not part of YaTeam.
widget.codex_aucun_releve: No data yet: it will appear after {nom}'s next task
widget.claude_deconnecte: Claude Code is not signed in
mcp.instructions_mac_seul: YaTeam: Claude is the project lead, helped by the user's Mac.
mcp.instructions_mac: {nom} is the team's “Mac” member: reminders (mac_lire_rappels, mac_ajouter_rappels, mac_cocher_rappels), calendar (mac_calendrier), notes (mac_note), opening an app (mac_ouvrir_app){question}; mac_lire_journal reads back the log of its actions. No Mac tool sends messages, emails or invitations, and none reads the calendar. Reminders, events and notes: create them when the user asks, otherwise suggest it in one line and wait for a yes. You may read their Reminders without asking; add or check off items only when they ask. After a timeout, read the log or the Reminders before trying again.
mcp.instructions_mac_question: , a quick question to Apple Intelligence, handled on the Mac without anything leaving it ({outil}: it only sees the text you give it)
mcp.instructions_images_plusieurs: You cannot generate images: faire_une_image has {auteurs} make them (auteur parameter; {defaut} by default; if one has used up its image quota, switch to another), and YOU choose the project folder to save them in and their file name.
mcp.outil_mac: Asks {nom} a quick question: it is Apple Intelligence, the Mac's own AI model, answering on the device (nothing leaves the Mac). Good for rephrasing, summarizing a short text or a small question. No web, no files: it only sees the text you give it. Answers in a few seconds.
mcp.param_question: The question or text to process, complete.
mcp.outil_lire_rappels: Reads the Mac's Reminders. Without a list: the lists and how many items each has to do. With a list: its items to do (and the latest checked ones if avec_faits). Changes nothing.
mcp.param_liste_lire: Optional: name of the list to read (no list: all lists).
mcp.param_avec_faits: Optional: true to also see the 50 most recently checked items.
mcp.outil_ajouter_rappels: Adds one or more items to a Reminders list on the Mac (default list if none is given), with an optional due date (alert at that time). Only when the user asks.
mcp.param_elements_ajouter: The items to add (one text per item).
mcp.param_liste_ajouter: Optional: list name (otherwise the default list).
mcp.param_echeance: Optional: due date, YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (Mac time).
mcp.outil_cocher_rappels: Checks off (or unchecks) items in a Reminders list, by their exact name; never deletes anything. A name that is only close is not checked: it is suggested. Only when the user asks.
mcp.param_elements_cocher: The item names, as they appear in the list.
mcp.param_decocher: Optional: true to uncheck instead of check.
mcp.outil_calendrier: Creates an event in the Mac's default calendar, without inviting anyone. All-day: dates without a time, the end being the last day. Only when the user asks (otherwise, suggest it).
mcp.param_debut: Start: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM (Mac time), or YYYY-MM-DD for an all-day event.
mcp.param_fin: End: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM, or YYYY-MM-DD (last day) for an all-day event.
mcp.outil_note: Creates a note in the Mac's Notes app. Only when the user asks (otherwise, suggest it).
mcp.outil_ouvrir_app: Opens a Mac app by name (displayed name or file name, without “.app”). If the name does not exist, nothing is opened and close names are suggested.
mcp.outil_lire_journal: Reads back the log of {nom}'s actions on this Mac (reminders, events, notes, apps, images, questions), most recent last. Useful to check that an action went through before trying it again.
mcp.q_antigravity_reconnexion: {nom}: no reading, Antigravity asks to sign in to Google again (no page was opened). Run “agy” once in Terminal to sign in again.
mcp.q_mac: {nom} (the Mac): no quota, everything happens on the Mac.
mcp.j_reconnexion: Antigravity asks to sign in to Google again (no page opened)
img.q_reussie_depuis: an image has succeeded since, on {date}
img.session_introuvable: Codex session of this task not found (reference {marque}): no image was taken, so as not to save one from another task.
mac.consignes_modele: You help the user on their Mac. Answer in English, briefly and clearly.
mac.journal_vide: The Mac log is empty: no action has been done yet.
mac.e_occupe: {nom} is busy with another action: try again in a few seconds.
mac.e_app_absente: The “YaTeam Mac” app is missing (~/.claude/equipe/YaTeamMac.app): run “Modify YaTeam” again to rebuild it.
mac.e_pas_de_reponse: No answer from the Mac in {s} s: a permission request (“YaTeam Mac would like to access your reminders / your calendar”) may be waiting on screen. In principle nothing was changed; if in doubt, check before trying again.
mac.e_arguments: Incomplete request for the Mac (internal YaTeam error).
mac.e_acces_rappels_refuse: Access to Reminders denied: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Reminders > turn on “YaTeam Mac”.
mac.e_acces_calendrier_refuse: Access to Calendar denied: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Calendars > “YaTeam Mac”: choose “Add Events Only”.
mac.e_listes_homonymes: Several lists are called “{nom}” (accounts: {comptes}): nothing was done.
mac.e_pas_de_liste_par_defaut: No default Reminders list: give a list.
mac.e_autorisation_tardive: Permission was given too late: nothing was changed, make the request again.
mac.e_dates_illisibles: Event title or dates missing or unreadable.
mac.e_pas_de_calendrier_par_defaut: No default calendar on this Mac (Calendar app > Settings > General).
mac.e_ia_indisponible: Apple Intelligence is not available on this Mac: {raison}.
mac.e_delai: Timed out ({s} s): nothing was changed.
mac.raison_appareil: this Mac is not compatible (an Apple chip is required)
mac.raison_desactivee: it is turned off (System Settings > Apple Intelligence & Siri)
mac.raison_pas_prete: the model is not ready yet (still downloading?), try again later
mac.listes_plusieurs: Several lists match “{nom}”: {listes}. Say which one.
mac.liste_faits: , {total} checked in all (the {montres} most recent are shown)
mac.ajouter_vide: At least one item to add is needed.
mac.date_illisible: Unreadable date: “{texte}”. Expected format: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM.
mac.cocher_vide: The list name and at least one item to check are needed.
mac.decocher_vide: The list name and at least one item to uncheck are needed.
mac.pas_exact: “{nom}”: no exact item; close: {proches} (ask again with the exact name)
mac.introuvable_a_faire: “{nom}”: not found among items to do
mac.titre_vide: Empty title: write the event name.
mac.date_manquante_debut: Start date missing or unreadable: “{texte}”. Expected format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DD.
mac.date_manquante_fin: End date missing or unreadable: “{texte}”. Expected format: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM or YYYY-MM-DD.
mac.fin_avant_debut: The end must be after the start.
mac.note_vide: A title and a text are needed to create the note.
mac.e_dossier_notes: No “{dossier}” folder in Notes: nothing was created. Choose an existing folder, or none.
mac.conseil_applications: Check the name shown in the Applications folder.
mac.app_introuvable: No “{nom}” app on the Mac, nothing was opened.
script.garde_impossible: Browser guard unavailable: {nom} was not started.
script.reconnexion: Antigravity asks to sign in to Google again: {nom} cannot answer (no page was opened). Run “agy” once in Terminal to sign in again, then try again.
script.quota_epuise: {nom}'s quota is used up{delai}: it cannot answer for now.
inst.activer_mac: Add your Mac to the team (Reminders, Calendar, Notes, apps, Apple Intelligence)?
inst.aucun_membre: No member can be installed: Codex CLI, Antigravity CLI, or a Mac on macOS 14 with Apple's Command Line Tools is needed. Install one, then run this again.
inst.mac_impossible_systeme: Mac member unavailable: macOS 14 or later is needed (this Mac: {version}).
inst.mac_impossible_swift: Mac member unavailable: Apple's Command Line Tools are missing (xcode-select --install).
inst.plan_mac: build the “YaTeam Mac” app (Reminders, Calendar, Apple Intelligence) and have it ask for its permissions
inst.plan_kit: keep a copy of the kit in ~/.claude/equipe/kit, to change the team later
inst.explication_mac: A small app without windows, built on this Mac in a few seconds. It has its own permissions: Reminders, Calendar for adding only (it never reads your calendar) and Notes.
inst.mac_a_jour: app already up to date (granted permissions are kept)
inst.mac_echec: YaTeam Mac app not built: Reminders, Calendar and Apple Intelligence questions will not work (run the installation again later)
inst.ia_non: Apple Intelligence: unavailable ({raison}); the Mac will handle Reminders, Calendar, Notes and apps.
inst.explication_autorisations: macOS will now ask for “YaTeam Mac” to access your Reminders, your Calendar (adding events only), then to control Notes (to create the notes you ask for). Answer “Allow” or “OK” each time: Claude will be able to read and check off your lists, and add the events and notes you ask for. You can change your mind in System Settings > Privacy & Security.
inst.acces_rappels_non: Reminders: access not granted; to turn it on: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Reminders > “YaTeam Mac”
inst.acces_calendrier_non: Calendar: access not granted; to turn it on: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Calendars > “YaTeam Mac”
inst.explication_connecteur: This is how Claude discovers the team: at every start, it presents the chosen members and their tools.
inst.remplacer_connecteur_code: Claude Code already has a connector named “equipe” that does not come from YaTeam. Replace it?
inst.connecteur_code_ajoute: “equipe” connector added to Claude Code (for all your sessions)
inst.echec_connecteur_code: connector not added to Claude Code (the Claude app has it)
inst.kit_copie: kit copied to {dossier} (the panel uses it for “Change the team…”)
inst.kit_deja: installation started from the kit copy: nothing to copy
inst.echec_kit: could not copy the kit: to change the team later, open “Installer YaTeam” again from the downloaded folder
inst.fin_exemple_antigravity: Try: “Ask {nom} to summarize the README in this folder.”
inst.fin_modifier: Add or remove an AI, change the language or the nicknames: “Change the team…” in the YaTeam panel settings, or open “Installer YaTeam” again.
inst.f_question_codex:
Add ChatGPT to the team?

Read-only team member, via Codex CLI and your ChatGPT account: reviews, checks, second opinions, images.
inst.f_question_antigravity:
Add Gemini to the team?

Read-only team member, via Antigravity CLI and your Google account: web research with sources, large documents, images.
inst.f_question_mac:
Add your Mac to the team?

Claude will be able to read and check off your Reminders, add events to your Calendar, create notes, open apps, and (if your Mac has it) ask Apple Intelligence questions. Nothing is sent: no messages, emails or invitations.
inst.f_widget:
Install the YaTeam panel?

Sitting on the desktop, it shows everyone's quotas and who is working. Built on this Mac in 1 to 3 minutes.
inst.f_suivez: Installing: the details show in this Terminal window.
desinst.f_confirmer:
Uninstall YaTeam?

These will be removed: the hooks, the “equipe” connector (Claude app and Claude Code), the agents, the CLAUDE.md rule and the panel. The {dossier} folder (scripts, settings, kit copy, YaTeam Mac app) will go to the Trash. A backup of every changed file is kept.
desinst.fin_mac: The permissions given to “YaTeam Mac” stay listed in System Settings > Privacy & Security; you can remove them there.
widget.mac_sans_quota: None · everything happens on the Mac
widget.agy_reconnexion: {nom} asks to sign in to Google again: readings paused. Click “Reconnect…” in Settings, then “Refresh”.
widget.connexions_aide: “Reconnect…” opens Terminal on the official sign-in command, with instructions: follow them, then close the window. Readings resume on their own.
widget.reco_navigateur: A sign-in page will open in your browser: sign in, then come back here.
widget.reco_agy_1: 1. Antigravity starts. If a Google page opens, sign in with the account of your subscription, then come back here.
widget.reco_agy_2: 2. When Antigravity waits for a question, you are connected: close this window.
widget.reco_fin: Done: you can close this window.
widget.reconnexion_demandee: Asks to sign in to Google again
widget.modifier_equipe_aide: Add or remove an AI, change the language or the nicknames: the questions show in windows. Then quit and reopen the Claude app.
widget.kit_absent: Kit copy not found (~/.claude/equipe/kit): open “Installer YaTeam” again from the downloaded folder.
widget.mac_aide: No quota: everything happens on the Mac. Every successful action is written to the log; access (Reminders, Calendar, Notes) is managed in System Settings > Privacy & Security.
widget.releves_aide: Readings use nothing. ChatGPT is read from the Codex history after each task; the Mac has no quota.
widget.prevenir: Notify when a quota goes over
widget.notification_essai_corps: Quota alerts will look like this.
widget.notifications_refusees: Notifications denied: allow “YaTeam” in System Settings > Notifications.
widget.demo_action_mac: Added to the “Groceries” list: bread, butter
mac.e_acces_notes_refuse: Control of Notes denied: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation > “YaTeam Mac” > turn on Notes.
inst.acces_notes_non: Notes: control not granted; to turn it on: System Settings > Privacy & Security > Automation > “YaTeam Mac” > Notes
